topic: The Great Wall of China cannot be seen from space — it was never true
hook: The Great Wall of China cannot be seen from space. Never could.
script: The Great Wall of China cannot be seen from space. Never could. The wall is 6000 kilometres long but only 5 to 8 metres wide. From space, you can't distinguish it from any road. Chinese astronaut Yang Liwei looked for it during his 2003 mission. He saw nothing. The myth started in a geography textbook in 1932 and nobody questioned it for 70 years. Follow for facts that prove popular knowledge wrong.
